summary: Freightos Ltd, a Nasdaq-listed Israeli-domiciled freight-booking platform, furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) covering the period ended June 30, 2026, containing interim IFRS financial statements and segment, revenue, share-based-payment, warrant and RSU tagging data across its Platform and Solutions segments by geography. No transactional event, stake acquisition, tender, buyback, delisting, restructuring or management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic earnings report, and no special-situation angle or deal terms are present; watch for ordinary operating results rather than event-driven risk arbitrage.
